denominators.governedTargetSpecification: Organization-owned target meaning; one specification may have many publisher implementations.
denominators.publisherTargetImplementationIdentity: One publisher's implementation of one target face/design lineage; color, paper/tag/cardboard, package, and quantity variants do not create another identity unless geometry/artwork meaning materially changes.
denominators.commercialSkuPackageOffering: A separately sold SKU/page/package/material/color/quantity configuration; duplicate category evidence does not create another offering.
denominators.nonTargetAccessoryConsumable: Commercial catalog record that is not itself the shootable target or target system.

policy: Conservative fail-closed grouping: exact organization designations and explicit publisher variants collapse; ambiguous face relationships remain separate.

correctedCumulative.caveat: The prior seven-publisher baseline was not re-audited in this assignment; this cumulative result adds the audited Batch #8-#11 denominator to that accepted baseline.
